sent:
Lena—

Short: Your product pages bury three trust boosts you already have: 180+ reviews (4.8/5), free resizing within 30 days, and Find Your Ring Size. When paid clicks land there, those persuaders are off‑screen in the moments that decide the sale.

10 quick wins:

1) Seafoam landing first screen (one ad, one promise):
- Hero: Seafoam on hand for scale.
- Price and Add to Bag.
- Stars + “180+ reviews, 4.8/5” (link to all).
- “Free resizing within 30 days” next to the CTA.
- “Find your ring size” link by the size selector and CTA.
- “Hand‑finished in Brighton · 100% recycled silver” line.
- “Ships in 3–5 days · Free UK shipping £75+”.

2) Route paid clicks off the homepage:
- Stacking angle → Seafoam offer page built for stacking.
- Sustainability/maker angle → short “Made in Brighton from recycled silver” offer page.
- Gifting/confidence angle → ring sizing + free resize page.
Each ad → its own page. One promise per page.

3) Creative test plan (3x3):
- Hands (movement, natural light).
- Scale (on-hand close-up; next to everyday objects).
- Stacking (three rings together; price callout).
Ship three variants for each; retire anything after three weeks of falling click‑through.

4) Show scale early on product pages: first gallery image “on hand”, not just macro.

5) Pull reviews into the first screen: stars + count + one-line summary; full reviews lower.

6) Surface dispatch and threshold by price/CTA: “Ships in 3–5 days · Free UK shipping £75+”.

7) Ring-size UX: repeat “Find your ring size” under the selector, by the CTA, and again in cart.

8) Tracking sanity check: pick one source of truth; count purchases (ideally first orders) as the KPI; make sure add-to-cart, begin checkout, and purchase fire once each.

9) Cart reassurance: near the subtotal, restate “Free resizing within 30 days” and returns/shipping basics to prevent last‑minute drop‑off.

10) Q4 gift routes: create a simple “Gifts under £50” offer page and a “Giftable rings (resize‑friendly)” page; send gifting ads to those, not to the grid.

PS: When Meta’s new unified Generative Ads Model (GEM) appears in your account this month, keep copy minimal and feed it clean assets from the three concepts above; Meta’s team reports up to 18.9% more conversions and 12% higher CTR with GEM: https://engineering.fb.com/2026/10/13/ml-applications/generative-ads-model-gem-scaling-frontier-ads-ai/

If useful, I can sketch the Seafoam and “Gifts under £50” layouts you can paste straight into a page builder.
